summary.text: Kevin Jackson is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 20 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A financial advisor and former educator, he earned his degrees at Western Kentucky University.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Jackson earned a B.S. and an M.A. in educational leadership and administration from Western Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as a financial advisor with Studle Financial Services and as an educator.
He took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, as the successor to Patti Minter.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Economic Development and Workforce Investment, Primary and Secondary Education, and Licensing, Occupations, and Administrative Regulations committees.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
